evidence.gate: 3/4 pass; P1 <=100% fails. One adaptively reused development seed, not final-test evidence.
evidence.specialist: Previously fixed TRAIN101_479 can jointly fit u0.757%/P117.889% with a dedicated same-recipe model; this does not isolate absent geometry information from shared optimization/interference.
evidence.inference: Existing point pooling, query context, learned Hash gate and scalar edge distances do not supply an explicit elastic inter-node operator. This is a representation gap to test, not a proven error cause.

Distance caches alone do not constitute a persistent coarse CSR graph or a stiffness operator.

ranked_candidates.name: Topology-preserving coarse mesh message context
ranked_candidates.question: Does learned communication along the volume mesh, rather than independent cloud pooling or another scalar distance, improve shared u/P1 representation?
ranked_candidates.mechanism: Construct a deterministic two-level hierarchy from actual corner-mid mesh edges, preserving components and support/load roles. Process coarse node/edge latents, then sparse topology-derived prolongation supplies32-dimensional context at sampled original nodes. Replace the existing query32 slots, retain global32/original43/coarse8 Hash, rather than append another32 channels; both new controls use this same interface.
ranked_candidates.bounded_shape_proposal: Illustrative fixed caps2048/128 coarse nodes, latent32 and one fixed down/up message schedule; these are proposals, not measured choices or a radius/depth sweep. Preserve original connectivity evidence and input DOF/load roles in both controls.
ranked_candidates.inputs: Physical relative edge vectors/L, cell-volume aggregation, same material/L and original support/load roles. No target u/stress, predicted teacher field or sample-ID feature. All9 response channels retain external source alpha and load linearity.
ranked_candidates.control: Fresh same decoder width and graph encoder, same nodes/prolongation/roles/latent widths/stored parameters/RNG. Compare actual mesh-neighbor messages against a self-only processor using the same modules. Native107-condition layout can remain unchanged, but graph parameters replace the old query projection and counts must be measured. Active communication differs; no pure topology-causality claim or historical-control substitution.
ranked_candidates.recomputation: Only static hierarchy/CSR/prolongation may be cached. Learned messages and query context must be recomputed for sampled CADs each optimizer step with gradients into the encoder; do not freeze a pretrained target-dependent graph cache.
ranked_candidates.continuous_limit: Initial utility trial evaluates original nodes and current physical P1. Arbitrary-point context later requires element location and a declared conforming interpolation, including TETRA10 geometry; nearest-node copying cannot establish continuous-field correctness.

costs.preparation: One target-independent graph contraction/prolongation per selected CAD; original graphs can be reconstructed from existing geometry. Actual coarsening runtime, nonzeros and source-to-query reach must be measured before claiming low cost.
costs.training: Coarse message cost O(B*E_coarse*z^2) plus sparse query gathers, not fullN hidden-state backpropagation. With B4,z32,(2048+128) nodes, one nodal latent activation is about1.06MiB; a51200x32 query activation is6.25MiB. Edge activations and backward dominate and are currently unmeasured.
costs.no_claim: No measured speedup, exact global receptive field or memory fit is asserted.

missing: Topology-preserving coarse hierarchy and sparse interpolation; retain thin bridges and distinct BC roles instead of spatial shortcut edges.
Measured coarse reach/edge counts and exact input-gradient path through the existing native decoder.
A control-specific fresh parameter count/init and runtime acceptance; current PointNet clouds are not a volume graph.
ranked_candidates.falsifiable_small_trial: If root later selects it, begin with the previously fixed4 TRAIN CADs101_428/101_479/101_56/101_78 x3knownloads, one matched1000-update pilot with shared exposure and frozen current loss/scaler. Require joint TRAIN u/P1 utility over self-only control before considering40/5 escalation. A TRAIN-only gain cannot establish CAD transfer; no gain or loss tradeoff rejects automatic escalation. Numeric gates would be frozen by root before execution, not chosen from this note.
ranked_candidates.real_contribution_if_validated: An efficient, traceable topology/BC-conditioned mesh-to-query interface and demonstrated shared/CAD joint u-P1 utility with a continuous decoder. Graph messages, hierarchy or Hash encoding themselves are established methods.

ranked_candidates.name: Frozen coarse elastic response context plus Hash residual
ranked_candidates.question: Would an input-derived nonlocal elastic response, rather than a learned geometric descriptor, supply the missing whole-deformation structure?
ranked_candidates.mechanism: Build a small Galerkin operator Kc=P^T K_P1 P from physical element geometry and E,nu, with a prolongation retaining rigid-body modes and constrained DOFs. Solve the three canonical ver/hor/tor RHS once per CAD; prolong the resulting9 physical u responses, use them as context and optionally as an additive base for the same9 Hash residual response. External alpha preserves linear load combination.
ranked_candidates.physical_units: Use mm,N,Nmm and E inN/mm2; K has unitsN/mm and u ismm. Reuse fixed common train-only uRMS for a declared decoder transform, not a newly fitted scaler.
ranked_candidates.control: If selected, use two fresh identically enlarged residual decoders and stored parameters with physical base/context active versus explicitly zero base/context. This tests utility of an input-derived solver prior; extra active information/effective capacity and initialization outputs differ. It is not equivalent to the historical coarse8 model.

costs.preparation: Assembly/projection is O(number_of_original_cells) and may be significant; three sparse RHS share one CAD operator. Illustrative512 aggregates with six rigid modes each gives around3072 coarse unknowns. Sparse factorization fill/cost must be measured; do not cache dense matrices for45CADs or promise seconds.
costs.training: Freeze the input-only sparse solve/cache, so per-step cost is query interpolation and the residual decoder; no full solver differentiation is required for this first hypothesis.
costs.no_claim: A cornerP1 coarse proxy is not the source quadratic Nastran solve or solver-GT strain.

blockers: Exact RBE2/RBE3/MPC interpolation/constraint matrices and force/moment work transfer are not established by existing member flags/load_basis guard. Do not uniformly distribute master loads or replace real rigid links with guessed mesh shortcuts.
Rigid-mode preservation, constrained DOF handling, positive operator and load-work consistency need input-only verification.
No faithful coarse operator/prolongation or measured sparse-solve implementation currently exists.
ranked_candidates.falsifiable_small_trial: After those input-only blockers are resolved and only if selected by root, freeze one coarse operator on historical TRAIN101_479, verify rigid/affine and force-moment work tests, then assess its three known-load u/P1 references in a bounded diagnostic. If the base has no joint utility, do not deploy a shared Hash-residual training pair. If useful, the eventual40/5 matched pair must use existing full-node gates and separate the solver-only base from learned residual metrics.
ranked_candidates.real_contribution_if_validated: A budgeted coarse elastic influence basis coupled to a geometry-conditioned continuous residual, with explicit BC transfer and joint displacement/gradient evidence. Galerkin reduction, linear elasticity and residual correction are not new.

source_verification.title: Cao et al., ICML2023 Bi-Stride Multi-Scale GNN
source_verification.verified: Publisher abstract describes BFS bi-stride pooling, avoidance of wrong proximity edges across boundaries and non-parametric pooling/unpooling. This motivates topology-preserving hierarchy, not a guarantee for DeepJEB static elasticity.

source_verification.title: Original Google DeepMind MeshGraphNets core
source_verification.verified: Official code updates edge states from sender/receiver/edge features, aggregates incoming edge messages and uses residual encoder-processor-decoder blocks. Dynamic simulation code is not a drop-in static DeepJEB operator.

source_verification.title: Official DOLFINx elasticity/AMG demo
source_verification.verified: Demonstrates isotropic linear elasticity assembly, constrained solve and six rigid-body near-nullspace modes for AMG. Its box/body-force example does not supply DeepJEB RBE coupling or signed scalar stress semantics.

decision_boundary: Priority1 is lower implementation risk. Priority2 has stronger explicit physics but unresolved BC work-transfer requirements. Neither is selected: sole active pathdiagnostic stays unchanged, and root decides after its actual result.
exclusions: No stress constitutive GT claim, final-test/dia access or overfit-as-generalization claim.
No arrays/models/training or frozen source/plan/report edits performed for this proposal.
